'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is [[Luuk Herssen]]'s younger adoptive brother, who suffered a chronic illness and was able to endure the Ichor treatment. However, his body started rejecting the Ichor overtime and later became bedridden.<ref>[[Luuk Herssen/Backstory#Storm|Luuk Herssen, Storm]]</ref>

Rhein's favorite candy brand is Sunshine Bear, which have long been discontinued<ref>[[Luuk Herssen/Backstory#Cherished Items|Luuk Herssen, Cherished Items]]</ref> and loves the magazine series called "The Minimalist Approach to Cat Psychology".<ref>[[All That Sunlight Touches#Flavor Text|All That Sunlight Touches, Flavor Text]]</ref>
